name: warm-street-cafe-portrait
image_purpose: casual-chic cafe portrait and environment reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic casual lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman seated at a cozy cafe or courtyard.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, warm complexion, natural glam makeup, gold hoop earrings, light gray blazer over a black top, and a soft approachable smile while holding a coffee cup.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium close-up, eye-level, head and upper torso visible, softly blurred brick wall, wooden beams, warm wall lights, potted plants, and outdoor seating.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused ambient light with warm artificial accents, late-afternoon or early-evening inviting mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone or mirrorless portrait, 4:5, natural perspective, shallow background bokeh, high subject sharpness, subtle warmth.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long wavy dark-brown hair and gold hoops sits at a cozy street cafe wearing a light gray blazer over a black top, holding a coffee cup and smiling softly at the camera. Use brick, wood, warm wall lights, potted plants, outdoor seating, and gentle late-afternoon bokeh. No watermark or invented logo.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothing, distorted hands, plastic skin, harsh shadows, fake text, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.

assets.name: warm-street-cafe-portrait_0.jpg
assets.usage: Identity, hair, outfit, cup, cafe environment, framing, and warm light reference.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required local image. Preserve approved adult identity, hair, outfit, cup, cafe, framing, palette, and light; replaceability applies only to the identity with an approved reference. Keep background marks and typography absent or generic.
